info.title: Facial Analysis API
info.description: HTTP service around the `facescan` core. Stateless: results travel back to the client in result tokens (compressed JSON) that later calls send back. Frontal and profile analysis, adjustments, overlays, and reports with considerations from the rules file. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`.

get.description: Ready once every worker has created its engine and run the warm-up analysis, and RAQM (Thai text in overlays) is available.
`engine.client_config(locale)` plus upload limits, overlay layers, the rules version and versions. Cacheable (`ETag`, 1 h).

post.summary: Analyze a frontal photo or burst
post.description: One photo, or a burst of 3–15 frames of identical size in capture order. Capture outcomes (`no_face`, `multiple_faces`, `quality_failed`) are 200 responses with hints and no token.

frames.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP as captured: no resizing, cropping or re-encoding.

post.summary: Apply point adjustments to a result
post.description: Recomputes a token's result with moved points, without the image. Every override is recorded as a user adjustment; only `user_adjustable_points` of the token's view may move. Profile silhouette points are re-snapped to the stored contour by the core, whatever coordinates were sent. Returns a new token (same session) and no overlay.

post.summary: Draw an overlay for a result
post.description: Redraws a token's result on its reference image (the reference frame or photo exactly as uploaded, or the profile photo) after adjustments. JPEG, long side ≤ OVERLAY_MAX_SIDE, no EXIF.

image.description: The result's reference image as originally uploaded.

post.description: A true 90° profile photo; `facing` is the direction the nose points in the image. With a `frontal_token` (from `/v1/frontal/analyze` or `/v1/adjust` of the same session) the subject and `session_id` come from it (a different `subject` in `meta` → 400 `subject_mismatch`) and mm values use its scale. Without one, `subject` is required, a new session starts and mm values are unavailable (warning `no_frontal_scale`). The result includes the silhouette `contour` and the points the user may adjust. Capture outcomes (`no_face`, `multiple_faces`, `contour_failed`, `quality_failed`) are 200 responses with hints and no token.

image.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP as captured.

post.description: Combines the session's frontal result and, optionally, its profile result into the report with considerations from the rules file. Both tokens must share a `session_id` (otherwise 400 `session_mismatch`). The response is `user_view(report)`: each consideration with its triggering measurements and reference range, the advice to consult a licensed surgeon, and the disclaimer. No token is returned.

report.consideration_intro: Features you may want to discuss with a licensed plastic surgeon

considerations.consult: Please consult a licensed plastic surgeon in person before making any decision.
